newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar tells Israel to respect PLO peace deals.
newsitem.headline: Qatar tells Israel to respect PLO peace deals.

text.p: Qatar's Emir sent his foreign minister to the Palestinian-ruled Gaza Strip on Monday and told Israel to respect its peace deals with the PLO.

Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani, addressing the opening session of Qatar's Shura (consultative) council, also urged Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to revive peace talks with Lebanon and Syria, stalled since his election in May.

"We affirm the need for Israel to respect deals signed with the Palestinian Authority, not to carry out any changes to the geographic or demographic features of Arab Jerusalem and to freeze its settlement activity in the West Bank", he said.

Netanyahu angered Arab states by challenging the key principle of land-for-peace and not carrying out some measures with the Palestine Liberation Organisation agreed under the previous Israeli government.

Qatar and Oman, members in the six-nation Gulf Cooperation Council, have forged ahead of other states in establishing economic ties with Israel but have stopped short of diplomatic relations pending the resolution of all Arab-Israeli conflicts.
They are the only states in the oil-rich region that have allowed Israel to set up trade missions.
Qatar's Foreign Minister, Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim al-Thani, was expected to arrive in Gaza on Monday for talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, Arafat's office said.
